Last Tuesday our nightly export job started failing on one customer account while every other account finished normally. The job reads rows from a reporting table, writes a CSV file, uploads it to object storage and then sends the customer an email with a download link. The failing account has about forty thousand rows, which is roughly average. The log shows that the upload step stops after the file reaches a little over fifty megabytes, and the next line says the connection was reset by the peer. We retried by hand three times and got the same result each time at nearly the same byte count. The storage provider status page shows no incident. Our proxy has a request timeout of sixty seconds, and the upload takes about fifty seconds on a good day, so we are close to that limit, but the other large accounts upload without trouble. The customer also changed their column mapping last week, which added several free-text columns that can hold long notes. The job runs on a small container with half a gigabyte of memory and no swap. Nothing in the container metrics shows memory pressure, though the sampling interval is one minute. We have not changed the job code in a month, the storage client library was updated two weeks ago, and the proxy configuration was last touched in the spring. I can share the exact log lines, the container settings and the proxy configuration if that helps. What should I check first?
